answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in trellis and dawn lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the cipher graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1589 impostors cost 1291 times the honest price and take 9 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
